info.title: Get My TG API
info.description:
API for purchasing and managing Telegram accounts.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints accept **either** credential (OR, not both required):

- **`x-api-key`** — API key from the Telegram bot (`/profile` → API keys)
- **`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`** — JWT from `POST /v1/web-auth/login` or `POST /v1/web-auth/registration` (web app / mini-app)

Public endpoints (service health, `GET /v1/accounts/countries`) do not require authentication.

ErrorReason.description:
Machine-readable business reason for client-side branching.
- INVALID_REQUEST: Malformed request payload, params, or query format.
- VALIDATION_ERROR: Validation failed for one or more request fields.
- INVALID_USER_ID_FORMAT: userId path/query parameter has invalid format.
- AUTH_REQUIRED: Missing credentials or failed authentication with API key/JWT.
- INVALID_TOKEN: JWT token is invalid or failed signature verification.
- TOKEN_EXPIRED: JWT token expired and must be refreshed.
- INVALID_API_KEY: API key is invalid or not recognized.
- API_KEY_DISABLED: API key exists but is disabled.
- API_KEY_EXPIRED: API key exists but has expired.
- ACCESS_DENIED: Authenticated client has no permission for target resource.
- RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Requested entity does not exist.
- PROMO_EXPIRED: Promo code activation window has ended.
- PROMO_DISABLED: Promo code is disabled by an administrator.
- PROMO_EXHAUSTED: Promo code global usage limit has been reached.
- PROMO_NOT_ACTIVE: User has no active pending promo code to cancel.
- CONFLICT: State conflict prevents operation completion.
- PURCHASE_IN_PROGRESS: A purchase with this idempotency key is still in progress.
- PURCHASE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: A purchase mutation may have reached its provider and must not be repeated automatically.
- ALREADY_EXISTS: Resource already exists with unique key conflict.
- INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: User balance is not enough for the requested operation.
- FAILED_PRECONDITION: Operation cannot proceed due to unmet business precondition.
- RATE_LIMITED: Request throttled by rate limiting.
- INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected server-side failure.
- SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Service is temporarily unavailable due to dependency/readiness issues.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description:
Browse and purchase Telegram accounts.

**Endpoints overview:**
- `GET /accounts/countries` — Public catalog with base prices (no auth required)
- `GET /accounts` — Personalized list with user's discounted prices (auth required)
- `GET /accounts/:country_code` — Detailed pricing breakdown with discount info (auth required)

**Pricing model.** Base prices are set per country. Authenticated users may receive a personal discount based on their purchase history (discount level). Use `/accounts/:country_code` to see the full price breakdown.

tags.name: Purchases by Hash
tags.description: Endpoints for accessing purchase details and requesting verification codes using a unique hash identifier instead of purchase ID. This allows retrieval of purchase information without authentication, using the hash as a secure access token.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Webhook testing and documentation.

## Webhook Payload Types

When you provide `callback_url` in `POST /purchases/:id/request-code`, your endpoint will receive one of the following payloads:

- **WebhookSuccessPayload** — sent when verification code is successfully retrieved
- **WebhookFailedPayload** — sent when code retrieval fails after all retry attempts

When you provide `callback_url` in `POST /purchases/bulk`, your endpoint will receive:

- **WebhookBulkReadyPayload** — sent when bulk archive is ready

See the **Models** section below for detailed payload structure.

## Requirements

- Your endpoint **must return HTTP 200** to acknowledge receipt
- Response timeout: **5 seconds**
- Failed deliveries are retried up to **3 times** (immediately, after 10s, after 30s)

## Testing

Use `POST /v1/webhooks/test` to verify your endpoint. Get a temporary test URL at https://webhook.site

get.description:
Returns paginated list of all available countries with **base pricing** (no user discount applied). No authentication required.

**Use case.** Public catalog for the website landing page. Shows general pricing and stock availability.

**Pricing.** Prices are base prices before any user discount. For personalized pricing, use `GET /accounts` (requires authentication).

**Filtering.** Use `country_codes` to request specific countries (e.g., `US,RU,GB`).

**Sorting options:** `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `name_asc`, `name_desc`, `popularity_asc`, `popularity_desc`.

**Sorting options:** `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `name_asc`, `name_desc`, `popularity_asc`, `popularity_desc`.

get.description:
Returns detailed pricing breakdown for a specific country, showing how the user's discount is applied.

**Response includes:**
- `price` — final price after user's personal discount
- `discount.base_price` — price before discount
- `discount.percent` — discount percentage applied

**Use case.** Account detail/checkout page where user needs to see both the original price and their discounted price.

**Example.** If base price is $3.00 and user has 10% discount:
- `price.amount`: `"2.70"`
- `discount.base_price`: `"3.00"`
- `discount.percent`: `10`

get.description: Own purchases and wholesale orders sorted and paginated together. Wholesale accounts appear only inside their order. Search matches country names in Russian or English, phone fragments (including accounts inside wholesale orders), and order ID fragments. Pending single purchases are listed separately.

phone_number.description:
**E.164 International Format.** Phone number with country code prefix (e.g., `+12025550123` for US, `+79991234567` for Russia).

**Usage.** This is your Telegram account login. Use it with `verification.code` and `verification.password` to access the account.

amount.description: Monetary amount as a string with up to 2 decimal places.

price.description:
**Final Price After Discount.** The actual amount deducted from your balance, with your personal discount already applied.

**To see pricing breakdown before purchase.** Check `GET /accounts/:country_code` which shows both discounted price and original `base_price`.

**Discount eligibility.** Based on your total successful purchase count. Higher volume = bigger discounts.

status.description:
**Purchase Status Lifecycle.** `PENDING` (initial) → `SUCCESS` (after code request) or `ERROR` (provider failure). Any status can transition to `REFUND` via admin action.

**Important.** Status is immutable once set to `SUCCESS`, `ERROR`, or `REFUND`.

**Filter options**
- `PENDING` - code not requested.
- `SUCCESS` - code ready.
- `ERROR` - provider failed.
- `REFUND` - money returned.

purchase_type.description: Type of purchase: SINGLE (regular), BULK (batch purchase), ADMIN (admin deduction)

purchase_source.description: Purchase channel: BOT (Telegram), WEB (site JWT), API (x-api-key)

verification.description:
**Verification Credentials.** Login credentials for the purchased Telegram account. Initially `null` after purchase creation.

**Availability.** Populated after calling `POST /purchases/:id/request-code`. Once received, credentials are permanent and cannot be re-requested.

**Security.** Verification data is only visible to the purchase owner.

received_at.description:

post.description:
Queues verification code retrieval. Active duplicate requests keep the original start time.

**Waiting policy.** The window is 20 minutes from the first code request. Retryable not_ready/provider_error responses continue beyond 18 attempts: pauses are 10 seconds after attempts 1–3 and 60 seconds from attempt 4. Timeouts use the shared attempt counter (limit 18) and 20/40/80/120-second backoff, capped at 120 seconds. A non-retryable response ends the request immediately.

**Completion.** A received code ends waiting. After terminal failure, repeated requests return failed without starting a new cycle; no automatic refund occurs. An already successful GMT purchase retains the existing code re-request behavior.

**Webhook notification.** Supply callback_url for a success or failed webhook; failed does not mean refunded.
